title: [Main] Expense Management: make core expense business objects public
summary: Expense Management core business objects are now publicly accessible for extensions to read, extend, release and post expenses, while keeping agent-specific and policy-related functionality internal.
key_points: 33 tables and 3 codeunits for expense and expense report operations made public with object-level access changed
9 status and type enums published to support public table usage
Agent service, approval lifecycle, policy evaluation, corporate card feed and AI-derived data remain internal
All public procedures documented with XML comments following System Application standards
Field-level access restrictions applied to credit card, extraction confidence, policy evaluation and approver fields
